$comment: Events shown on the home page. `date` accepts YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; anything on/after today lands in Upcoming, everything else in Past. `endDate`, `link` and `image` are optional. `title` and `place` accept either a plain string or { id, en } for per-language text. `link` may be an absolute URL (opens in a new tab) or a site-relative path without the language prefix, e.g. /news/some-slug (the current language is prepended). `image` may be a /content/assets/... path or a file under public/.
